info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payroll Benefits Retrieval API
info.description: The Payroll Benefits Retrieval API provides access to detailed information about employee payroll benefits within the human resource management system. Users can retrieve specific benefits associated with an employee or a department by utilizing unique parameters. This API is particularly useful for HR professionals and payroll administrators who need to manage and oversee employee benefits. By integrating this API, organizations can streamline their payroll processes and ensure accurate benefits management.

get.summary: Retrieve payroll and benefits information for a specific employee.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed payroll and benefits data associated with a specific employee identified by their unique employment number. Use this to ensure accurate financial and benefits management for your employees.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve payroll and benefits information for a specific employee identified by their employee number. The data returned will include various attributes related to the employee’s payroll and benefit details.

GetPayrollBenefitsForEmployeeRequest.description: A request body schema used for the GET operation in the human resource management payroll benefits system.

GetPayrollBenefitsForEmployeeResponse_20.title: Payroll Benefits Response

payrollRunId.description: Unique identifier for the payroll run.

payPeriod.description: The pay period for which the payroll run is applicable.

grossPay.description: Details of the gross pay for the employee.

deductions.description: Details of the deductions from the gross pay.

paymentDate.description: The date on which the payment is made.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the payroll record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: Version number of the payroll record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the payroll record.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the payroll response.
